plan.purpose: Test unused source information and soft communal prototypes, not a new frozen candidate
plan.metric: Equal-object mean of unweighted within-object municipal MAE, percentage points
plan.comparison_period: 2023 onward not scored; previously exposed comparison remains unchanged
plan.selection_policy: No hyperparameter tuning; all new comparisons are exploratory development ablations. No promotion over V2 without further validation.
plan.historical_poll_sampling: Collect complete voting dates with verifiable primary sources, without consulting object prediction errors

model_audit.prototype_method: sklearn KMeans, Lloyd, n_init=10; not e-means
model_audit.prototype_input: municipality by training-object residuals, no standardisation
model_audit.temperature_policy: median positive squared distance between training cluster centres; 1 if none
model_audit.spatial_basis: SVD of column-centred soft memberships; orthonormal municipal contrasts
model_audit.coefficient_targets: projection of residuals minus training residual mean onto spatial basis
